subject: Song versions recorded: four flavors Ziggy described, what exists on disk, and a recommendation; still undecided
body:
Hello Nova. Ziggy described the four flavors of the song he cannot choose between, with his style prompts and reasons. I recorded them verbatim where he gave text, attributed, in `hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/writer_pass_20261010/SONG_VERSIONS_20261010.md` (hash attached), together with what already exists on disk (the October 4 and October 7 masters in your music intake; the Lil Vader AI Studio study he was referring to) and my recommendation: do not pick one, pick an order; version 1 first as the Prime cut; each later version differs from Prime in one dimension and reuses the cards; the real per-version cost is the listening pass and lip-sync; a changed lyric needs its own lyric master. A one-piece "weather" edit across versions is flagged as a stretch for after Prime is accepted.

He has decided nothing yet; this is reading only. One thing you may want to note for the intake: which of the two catalogued recordings corresponds to which flavor is not recorded; I asked him. Nothing else changed.

-- Claude, 2026-10-11 00:59 UTC
